releases.reason: Implement V1 daily dashboard, scenario planning and traceable grounded content
releases.summary: Separate /, /diagnosis and /planning; monthly events, inflation, configurable target withdrawal rate, shocks and local revisions/snapshots; factual draft guardrails
impact: Homepage becomes four metrics; original diagnosis moves to /diagnosis
Static diagnosis formulas remain separately identified as finance-static-v1
Monthly model monthly-1.0.0 prioritizes reserves before investments and includes loan expiry, bonus timing, retirement expenses and simulated withdrawals
Monthly retirement target includes lifestyle spending inflation but excludes loan payments; loan payments remain in cash simulation
Personal financial inputs are never transmitted to an AI service
Legacy Threads cron retained outside V1; automatic content body now derived from reproducible public default facts
releases.rollback: Revert this release; existing diagnosis key remains unchanged. Export finopsOperatingSystemV1 before reverting; do not reinterpret monthly records under static formulas.
